notes.title: Trading Cards added to Burokku Girls!
notes.content:
Hi guys,

By popular request, we're hyped to reveal today that [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b] have been added to Burokku Girls!

You can collect a total of 10 epic trading cards, and each one includes a bit of story on the character. Plus you can pick up badges, profile backgrounds and more!

Have fun collecting them all!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/443980

- Silver Cow Studio

notes.title: Trading Cards added to Time Tenshi!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Hype time has arrived! After many requests, we're excited to announce the addition of [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b] to Time Tenshi!

There are a total of 7 awesome trading cards for you to collect, and each one includes some backstory on the character. Plus there's the usual rare goodies like badges, profile backgrounds and more!

Have fun collecting them all!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/420950]http://store.steampowered.com/app/420950[/url]

- Silver Cow Studio
